snippet.title: Hidalgo - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Embark on the most iconic and cozy adventures from the classic novel "Don Quixote of La Mancha". In a handcrafted, colorful puppet world, you'll battle windmills, be knighted, will solve puzzles with Don Quijote and Sancho and fight for the love of your beloved Dulcinea.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3157950/Hidalgo/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
